brackets.title: Coldridge Valley
brackets.summary: Your first hour or two: get your Imp, learn the basic Shadow Bolt + Immolate rhythm, and leave the snowy starter valley at about level 6.

steps.title: Start at Anvilmar – sell your spare gear for Immolate
steps.body: Gnomes start at Anvilmar in Coldridge Valley, the starter valley shared with dwarves. Sell your spare starting gear to a vendor so you can afford **Immolate** (a fire spell that burns over time) from the trainer right away. Early fights: cast Shadow Bolt, cast Immolate while the bolt is still flying, and finish the enemy with your weapon if you run out of mana.

npcs.name: Alamar Grimm
npcs.role: Warlock trainer (only teaches up to level 6)

steps.title: Imp quest: Tainted Memorandum → Beginnings
steps.body: Your first demon comes from a class quest. Take the **Tainted Memorandum** letter from Sten Stoutarm and bring it to Alamar Grimm inside Anvilmar; his follow-up **Beginnings** asks for 3 Feather Charms (games.gg lists it at level 4; in Classic the charms drop from Frostmane trolls in the valley). Keep the Imp out: it attacks from range and its **Blood Pact** buff gives you extra Stamina.

quests.name: Beginnings
quests.note: Bring 3 Feather Charms to Alamar Grimm

steps.title: Anvilmar quests
steps.body: Pick up everything around Anvilmar first, then do it in one loop: wolves for meat, the trogg camp, and Felix's three hidden boxes. At launch the valley will be packed and mobs are not shared between players, so group up with people on the same quest.

quests.name: A Refugee's Quandary
quests.note: From level 3. Felix's Box 20.9, 76.1 · Chest 22.8, 80.0 · Bucket of Bolts 26.3, 79.3

steps.title: Grelin Whitebeard's camp and the troll cave
steps.body: Talin Keeneye and Grelin Whitebeard's camp west of Anvilmar have the next batch. Kill troll whelps for The Troll Cave, then Grik'nir the Cold (30.5, 80.2) for the journal. Nori's Mornbrew delivery has a 5-minute timer – only accept it when you're ready to run straight back to Anvilmar.

quests.name: The Stolen Journal
quests.note: Kill Grik'nir the Cold at 30.5, 80.2

quests.name: Scalding Mornbrew Delivery
quests.note: Timed: deliver to Durnan Furcutter in Anvilmar (28.8, 66.4)

steps.title: Train at Alamar Grimm (levels 4 and 6)
steps.body: Visit the trainer every even level – there's always something new. Level 4: **Corruption** and **Curse of Weakness**, plus the Imp's **Blood Pact** grimoire (a book that teaches your demon a spell) from the demon trainer next door. Level 6: **Life Tap** (turns health into mana) and Shadow Bolt rank 2. Alamar only teaches up to level 6, so after that you train in Kharanos or Ironforge.

steps.title: Through the tunnel to Kharanos
steps.body: Hand in Felix's boxes and train, then take Senir's Observations to Mountaineer Thalos at the tunnel and grab Supplies to Tannok from Hands Springsprocket next to him. Walk through the tunnel – Kharanos is the town on the other side.

quests.name: Senir's Observations
quests.note: Speak with Mountaineer Thalos (33.5, 71.8)

brackets.title: Kharanos, Ironforge & eastern Dun Morogh
brackets.summary: Kharanos is your home base: bind your hearthstone, unlock camping and pick up professions. At 10 you visit Ironforge for talents and start the Voidwalker quest, then finish eastern Dun Morogh.

steps.title: Arrive in Kharanos – bind your hearthstone
steps.body: Turn in Senir's Observations to Senir Whitebeard and the crate to Tannok Frosthammer. Then talk to Innkeeper Belm and make the inn your home: your **Hearthstone** (in your bags) teleports you back here, with a cooldown. Logging out in an inn also builds **rested XP**, which doubles the XP you get from kills.

quests.name: Senir's Observations
quests.note: Turn in to Senir Whitebeard (46.7, 53.8)

quests.name: Supplies to Tannok
quests.note: Turn in to Tannok Frosthammer (47.2, 52.2)

steps.title: Unlock camping: The Great Outdoors
steps.body: Eric Brighthammer, by the campfire outside Kharanos, gives **The Great Outdoors**: type `/sit` at his fire for about a minute until you get the Boosted Rest buff, then learn Cooking in town to build your own campfires (sit 1 minute at any camp for an hour of buffs). **Bug fix:** if the quest won't complete – common if you already had a camp buff when you accepted it – abandon it, log out and back in, accept it again and `/sit` for a full minute; typing `/sit` worked when the X key didn't.

steps.title: Professions: Cooking + First Aid now, Tailoring + Enchanting in Ironforge
steps.body: Learn **Cooking** (campfires, plus food that gives bonus XP) and **First Aid** (bandages you can Life Tap back into mana; in Forever it also makes healing potions and cures) in the Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos – neither uses one of your two main profession slots. Your two main professions, **Tailoring + Enchanting** (the most-recommended warlock pair), are trained at the Great Forge in Ironforge once you get there around level 10. The Professions page covers how to level them.

steps.title: Kharanos & Steelgrill's Depot
steps.body: Kharanos and Steelgrill's Depot just east of it hand out the next wave. Most targets – boars, bears and the wendigos in the Grizzled Den (around 40, 48) – are close to town, so pick everything up first and clear them in one loop.

quests.name: Tools for Steelgrill
quests.note: Deliver to Beldin Steelgrill (50.4, 49.1)

quests.name: Operation Recombobulation
quests.note: Leper Gnomes around 27.6, 36.4

quests.name: The Grizzled Den
quests.note: Do it at about level 8

steps.title: Train with Gimrizz Shadowcog (Kharanos)
steps.body: Gimrizz Shadowcog in Kharanos is a full warlock trainer – visit him at 6, 8 and 10. Level 8 is a big one: **Bane of Agony** (a damage-over-time spell you'll open every fight with) and **Fear**. Demon grimoires are sold by Dannie Fizzwizzle next to him. Spell costs aren't published; the free 'What's Training? (Forever)' addon shows them in game.

steps.title: Brewnall Village and Frostmane Hold
steps.body: West of Kharanos, Brewnall Village (30.2, 45.6) sends you after bears, boars and snow leopards, Shimmerweed from the trolls on Shimmer Ridge, and a beer-swapping prank in the Kharanos inn basement. Frostmane Hold is a crowded troll cave – go at about level 9 and pull one troll at a time. Its turn-in gives **The Reports**, your ticket to Ironforge.

quests.name: Evershine
quests.note: Unlocks A Favor for Evershine at Brewnall

quests.name: The Perfect Stout
quests.note: Shimmerweed from Frostmane Seers around 41, 42

quests.name: Frostmane Hold
quests.note: Frostmane Headhunters around 24, 51

steps.title: Ironforge: The Reports, first flight path, Tailoring & Enchanting
steps.body: Take **The Reports** to Senator Barin Redstone in Ironforge, then talk to Gryth Thurden, the gryphon master, to unlock your first flight path. While you're here, learn **Tailoring** and **Enchanting** at the Great Forge and visit the warlock trainers in the Forlorn Cavern. The **Deeprun Tram** connects Ironforge and Stormwind in a few minutes – you'll use it for the Voidwalker quest.

quests.name: The Reports
quests.note: Deliver to Senator Barin Redstone in Ironforge

steps.title: Train in Ironforge's Forlorn Cavern (level 10)
steps.body: The Ironforge warlock trainers stand together in the Forlorn Cavern. Level 10 brings **Drain Soul** (makes Soul Shards, the reagent for most demons) and **Create Healthstone** (a free emergency heal – always keep one). Put your first talent point into **Improved Corruption**, which makes Corruption instant – every leveling guide starts with it. Talent resets are also done here, for a fee.

steps.title: Level 10: talents and the Voidwalker
steps.body: Two big unlocks: you get one talent point per level from now on, and your **Voidwalker** quest opens. The Voidwalker is a tank demon – it holds enemies off you while your DoTs (damage-over-time spells) and wand do the work – and most guides call it the best leveling demon until 20.

steps.title: Voidwalker quest: The Slaughtered Lamb → The Binding
steps.body: Gnomes start with **The Slaughtered Lamb** in Ironforge, which sends you by Deeprun Tram to **Gakin the Darkbinder** in the basement of the Slaughtered Lamb, Stormwind's Mage Quarter. He sends you to **Surena Caledon** at the Brackwell Pumpkin Patch in Elwynn Forest for her choker, then you summon and defeat a Voidwalker for **The Binding**. Ask a Stormwind guard for directions – sources give Stormwind coordinates for two different city maps, so we left them out. The steps after the first are the Classic chain as stored in the Forever database; re-check the quest text in game.

quests.name: The Slaughtered Lamb
quests.note: Report to Gakin the Darkbinder in Stormwind

quests.name: Surena Caledon
quests.note: Surena is at the Brackwell Pumpkin Patch

quests.name: The Binding
quests.note: Summon and subdue a Voidwalker, then return the choker

steps.title: Eastern Dun Morogh: Amberstill, Gol'Bolar Quarry and the gate
steps.body: Back in Dun Morogh, work east along the road. Protecting the Herd's target is an elite (a much tougher mob) – find a partner or skip it. Deliver the Shimmer Stout to Mountaineer Barleybrew at the eastern gate; he gives **Stout to Kadrell**, which leads you into Loch Modan.

quests.name: Protecting the Herd
quests.note: Elite target (Vagash) – group up

quests.name: The Lost Pilot
quests.note: Leads to A Pilot's Revenge – Mangeclaw at 78.3, 37.8

quests.name: Shimmer Stout
quests.note: Deliver to Mountaineer Barleybrew (86.3, 48.8)

brackets.title: Loch Modan, Hall of Thanes & Redridge
brackets.summary: Quest out of Thelsamar, run Hall of Thanes once with all five quests, start the Cozy Sleeping Bag hunt, then push to 20 in Redridge (or Westfall/Darkshore).

steps.title: Into Loch Modan: Thelsamar
steps.body: Walk east through the gate into Loch Modan and hand in Stout to Kadrell at Thelsamar, the town in the middle of the zone. Take the flight path from Thorgrum Borrelson and set your hearth at the Stoutlager Inn – Thelsamar is your base until the mid-teens.

quests.name: Stout to Kadrell
quests.note: Turn in to Mountaineer Kadrell in Thelsamar

steps.title: Thelsamar, Algaz Station and the Valley of Kings
steps.body: Loch Modan still runs on its classic quest chains in Forever (the dev notes only mention small changes, like Resupplying the Excavation at Miran's camp). Pick up everything in Thelsamar, then work south to Algaz Station and north-west to the Valley of Kings. Skip quests that turn grey – Forever has no level scaling and beta players regularly out-leveled zones.

quests.name: Filthy Paws
quests.note: Algaz Station

quests.name: In Defense of the King's Lands
quests.note: Valley of Kings

quests.name: Excavation Progress Report
quests.note: Ironband's Excavation Site

steps.title: Library books: Ironforge and Loch Modan
steps.body: Forever hides **library books** around the world; turn them in one at a time to Garion Wendell (top of the Mage Tower, Stormwind Mage Quarter) for rewards at 10, 20 and 25 books. Three are on your path: Ironforge's Hall of Explorers, upstairs in Thelsamar's inn, and a cave in Mo'grosh Stronghold (elite ogres – bring a friend). Grab them when you pass by; the Library page lists the rest.

items.name: Archmage Antonidas: The Unabridged Autobiography
items.note: Back room of the Hall of Explorers

items.name: Rumi of Gnomeregan: The Collected Works
items.note: Upstairs in the Stoutlager Inn; a copy in Westfall counts as the same book

items.name: Runes of the Sorcerer-Kings
items.note: Middle cave of Mo'grosh Stronghold (entrance 74.5, 19.6), level 19–20 elites

steps.title: Train in Ironforge at 12, 14, 16 and 18
steps.body: Thelsamar has no warlock trainer, so fly back to Ironforge on even levels – it fits nicely with your Hall of Thanes trip. 12: **Health Funnel** (heals your demon). 14: **Drain Life** and **Curse of Recklessness**. 16: **Unending Breath**; 18: **Create Soulstone** and **Searing Pain** – keep spending talent points in Affliction.

steps.title: Get a wand: Lesser (5) or Greater Magic Wand (13)
steps.body: Wands are your main damage between DoTs until about level 30 – they cost no mana. Enchanters make the **Lesser Magic Wand** (level 5) and **Greater Magic Wand** (level 13); craft them yourself if you took Enchanting, or buy one on the Auction House. Since the beta, wands don't benefit from spell power and you must stand still for half a second before each shot.

steps.title: Hall of Thanes prep: Earthseer Farsen and the Dark Iron Map
steps.body: The dungeon's last-boss quest starts out in Dun Morogh, so get it before you go in. Beldin Steelgrill (Steelgrill's Depot) points you to Earthseer Farsen at the camp above Gol'Bolar Quarry. Kill Dark Iron Spies for **Nip 'Em in the Bud** until one drops the **Dark Iron Map**, right-click the map to start a quest, and bring it to Farsen for **Old Ironforge Incursion**.

quests.name: A Visitor to Dun Morogh
quests.note: Optional breadcrumb

quests.name: Nip 'Em in the Bud
quests.note: 10 Dark Iron Spies around 76.7, 60.7 – one drops the Dark Iron Map

quests.name: Underground Map
quests.note: Deliver the map to Earthseer Farsen

quests.name: Old Ironforge Incursion
quests.note: Kill Durgen Dirgehammer in Hall of Thanes, bring his head to King Magni

steps.title: Hall of Thanes (13–18): one run with all five quests
steps.body: Hall of Thanes is the new Alliance dungeon under Ironforge: walk from the Great Forge into King Magni's hall and take the cobwebbed passage on the left (43.5, 52.0) down to the entrance. Grab **Important Heirlooms** and **The Restless Dead** on the way in, **An Ancient Grudge** in the second room, and loot the **Treaty of Understanding** tablet behind a vault door in the final room. Run it **once** with every quest – players measured dungeon mob XP at roughly a quarter of Classic, so the XP is in the quests – then go back to questing.

quests.name: Important Heirlooms
quests.note: By the bridge outside the dungeon

quests.name: The Restless Dead
quests.note: Up the stairs on the way to the entrance

quests.name: An Ancient Grudge
quests.note: Inside; turn in on your way out

quests.name: The Treaty of Understanding
quests.note: Turn in to King Magni Bronzebeard

npcs.name: King Magni Bronzebeard
npcs.role: Turn-in for Old Ironforge Incursion and the Treaty

steps.title: Cozy Sleeping Bag scavenger hunt (level 14+)
steps.body: This hunt across five zones gives the **Cozy Sleeping Bag**: lie on it for 3 minutes for up to +3% XP, stacking with food and camp buffs (1-hour cooldown). It starts at a **Nailed Plank** in Westfall (37, 50), then goes the Barrens → Stonetalon → Stonewrought Dam in Loch Modan (49, 12) → Thoradin's Wall in Hillsbrad, and must be done in that order – so do each leg when your route passes by. Some forum posts tie the chain to Loch Modan ('Wet Bags' on the dam), but the dam is the 4th stop, not the start.

quests.name: ...and that note you found
quests.note: Turn in at the Burned-Out Remains, The Barrens 46, 74

quests.name: Stepping Stones
quests.note: Leads to the Pocket Litter near Sun Rock Retreat, Stonetalon (gives Flint and Tinder + 3 Simple Wood)

quests.name: Scramble
quests.note: Mound of Dirt just east of the Pocket Litter

quests.name: Wet Job
quests.note: Ends at the Carved Figurine on a ledge of the Stonewrought Dam, Loch Modan 49, 12

quests.name: Eagle's Fist
quests.note: Ends at the Messenger Bag on top of Thoradin's Wall, Hillsbrad – climb the leaning cart

quests.name: This Must Be the Place
quests.note: Rewards the Cozy Sleeping Bag + 5 Student Fodder

steps.title: Option: Westfall (Sentinel Hill) or Darkshore (15–18)
steps.body: If Loch Modan runs dry, take the tram to Stormwind and head to Westfall – you need to go there for the sleeping bag anyway – and grab the Sentinel Hill flight path. The Deadmines (15–22) is here but optional for a gnome; Hall of Thanes is closer. Alternatively, the new Stormwind Harbor boat takes you to Auberdine for Darkshore (10–20).

quests.name: The Defias Brotherhood
quests.note: Deadmines chain – only if you plan to run it

steps.title: Train in Stormwind (16–20)
steps.body: When you're questing on the Stormwind side (Westfall, Redridge), train in the Mage Quarter instead of flying back to Ironforge. Ask any city guard for 'Warlock trainer' and it's marked on your map. The demon trainer Spackle Thornberry is nearby for grimoires.

steps.title: Merchant's Favor: Azeroth Commerce Authority (Three Corners)
steps.body: **Waylaid Crates** drop now and then from mobs and chests (or buy them on the Auction House): right-click one, fill it with the listed bundle (e.g. 40 Linen Cloth) and hand the sealed crate to **Marcy Baker** at the Azeroth Commerce Authority camp in Three Corners, west Redridge. You get **Merchant's Favor**, a currency for profession recipes such as Tailoring's Shadow-damage gear. Your first crate also gives a Shipping Label quest worth 50 Favor and 2,000 reputation. Don't delete crates – bank them; Apprentice and Journeyman crates need level 10 to open.

items.name: Shipping Label
items.note: From your first crate – starts a 50 Favor quest

npcs.name: Marcy Baker
npcs.note: Some beta posts placed the camp near Lakeshire; current guides say Three Corners

steps.title: Redridge Mountains (Lakeshire) 16–22
steps.body: Enter Redridge at Three Corners around 15–16, take the flight path south of Lakeshire's bridge and set your hearth at the Lakeshire inn. Redridge got lots of new Alliance quests in Forever, so pick up anything new you see. Messenger to Darkshire is your link to Duskwood later.

quests.name: The Price of Shoes
quests.note: Unlocks his other quests

brackets.title: Succubus/Incubus, Blackfathom Deeps & the Wetlands
brackets.summary: A big level-20 training day, your second demon quest on Kalimdor via the new Stormwind–Auberdine boat, Blackfathom Deeps for the Gravestone Scepter wand, and Wetlands questing (Duskwood is the alternative).

steps.title: Level 20: big training day in Stormwind
steps.body: Train **Demon Armor**, **Rain of Fire** (your first area spell), **Ritual of Summoning** (the only way to summon players in Forever – meeting stones no longer do) and **Curse of the Elements**. Your **Succubus/Incubus** quest unlocks, Expert professions open (with skill 125), and the 20-book library reward becomes available.

steps.title: Succubus or Incubus: Devourer of Souls / What Is Love?
steps.body: Ask **Gakin the Darkbinder** (Slaughtered Lamb basement, Stormwind) for **Devourer of Souls**, which sends you to **Takar the Seer** in the Barrens. Takar offers the Succubus hunt (**Heartswood**, Ashenvale) or the new Incubus one (**What Is Love?** – a Wooden Figurine in a house west of Maestra's Post, Ashenvale); bring it to Gakin and win **The Binding**. Both demons share the same spells, and Conquest Capped calls the Incubus quest the easier one. This is the chain stored in the Forever database – no beta write-up of the Alliance route exists, so re-check each quest's text.

quests.name: Devourer of Souls
quests.note: Speak with Takar the Seer in the Barrens

quests.name: Heartswood
quests.note: Succubus version

quests.name: What Is Love?
quests.note: Incubus version – follow the road north into Ashenvale, then west past Maestra's Post to a house in the trees

quests.name: The Binding
quests.note: Succubus

quests.name: The Binding
quests.note: Incubus

steps.title: New boat: Stormwind Harbor → Auberdine
steps.body: New in Forever: a boat leaves the southern-most dock of Stormwind Harbor for Auberdine in Darkshore, so you no longer need the long Wetlands detour to reach Kalimdor. Take the Auberdine flight path and use one trip for everything over there: the demon quest (Ashenvale + the Barrens), Blackfathom Deeps, and the Barrens/Stonetalon legs of the sleeping bag. There are no Alliance warlock trainers on Kalimdor, so train before you sail.

quests.name: Business in Auberdine
quests.note: Its quest text describes the new harbor boat

steps.title: Blackfathom Deeps (22–28): Gravestone Scepter
steps.body: Before you go in, collect **Knowledge in the Deeps** (Gerrig Bonegrip, Forlorn Cavern in Ironforge) and **Researching the Corruption** (Gershala Nightwhisper, Auberdine); the entrance is in the north-west of Ashenvale (14.5, 14.6), through an underwater cave. Inside, Argent Guard Thaelrid (near Ghamoo-ra) gives **Blackfathom Villainy**: kill Twilight Lord Kelris and take his head to Dawnwatcher Selgorm in Darnassus for the **Gravestone Scepter**, the best wand you can get before 30. You can accept it at 18 but will want to be 22+; run it once with all quests, then go back to questing.

quests.name: Blackfathom Villainy
quests.note: Inside the dungeon; turn in to Dawnwatcher Selgorm, Darnassus

quests.name: In Search of Thaelrid
quests.note: Optional, level 20

quests.name: The Orb of Soran'ruk
quests.note: Warlock-only, level 25: fragments from BFD and Shadowfang Keep → Staff or Orb of Soran'ruk

steps.title: Wetlands (Menethil Harbor) 21–25
steps.body: Wetlands is the gnome's natural zone for the 20s: walk north from Loch Modan through the Dun Algaz tunnel, take Menethil Harbor's flight path and set your hearth at its inn. Start with the harbour quests, then Rethiel the Greenwarden's gnoll chain, which later unlocks an Excavation Site dungeon quest. Forever added 25+ new Wetlands quests that guides haven't fully mapped yet – take new ones whenever you see them.

quests.name: The Greenwarden
quests.note: Outside the inn; leads to Rethiel the Greenwarden (56.3, 40.3)

quests.name: In Search of the Excavation Team

steps.title: Option: Duskwood (Darkshire) 20–25
steps.body: If you prefer the Stormwind side, carry **Messenger to Darkshire** from Redridge, take the flight path just west of Darkshire (77, 44) and bind at the inn. Darkshire hands out about two thirds of the zone's quests; do the Night Watch and Sven's Camp chains now and leave the elite group quests (Morbent Fel, Mor'Ladim) for 30+.

quests.name: Messenger to Darkshire
quests.note: Turn in to Lord Ello Ebonlocke in Darkshire

quests.name: The Night Watch
quests.note: From the Darkshire hub; the Night Watch camp is at 45, 67

steps.title: Train at 22 and 24
steps.body: Fly back from Menethil (or Darkshire → Stormwind) on even levels. 22: **Eye of Kilrogg**; 24: **Drain Mana** and **Sense Demons**. Demon trainers sell new grimoires too: Soothing Kiss (Succubus/Incubus) at 22 and Suffering (Voidwalker) at 24.

steps.title: Expert professions and Shadow-damage tailoring
steps.body: Once you're level 20 with skill 125, train Expert Tailoring from Georgio Bolero in Stormwind and Expert Enchanting from Kitta Firewind at the top of the Tower of Azora in Elwynn Forest. Tailors can buy Shadow-damage patterns for Merchant's Favor from Mivin Shadowweave at the Three Corners camp – e.g. Shadow Circlet (level 20) and Shadow Gown (level 22); only the tailor who makes them can wear them.

steps.title: Library books on the 20s route
steps.body: Three more books sit near this route: Whelgar's Excavation Site in the Wetlands, the Ruins of Mathystra in Darkshore (naga, levels 19–21) and the Dawning Wood Catacombs in Duskwood (level 27–28 undead – go later or with a friend). Twenty books gets you a ring with a spell-power option; the Library page has the full list.

brackets.title: Excavation Site, Southshore & the Felhunter
brackets.summary: Finish the Wetlands with one Excavation Site run, sail to Southshore, run City of Dalaran around 30 and start the Felhunter quest.

steps.title: Collect the Excavation Site quests (24–27)
steps.body: Collect the dungeon quests before you go in. Rethiel the Greenwarden's three gnoll quests (the Fen Creepers are invisible – listen for them along the rivers) unlock **Horrors in the Highland**; Caitlin Grassman in Menethil gives **Lost in the Thicket Things**; Dorin Songblade in Lakeshire, Redridge gives **Songblade Search** from level 24.

quests.name: Tramping Paws
quests.note: Then Fire Taboo and Blisters on the Land

quests.name: Lost in the Thicket Things
quests.note: Optional breadcrumb: Seeking Caitlin from Llana in Astranaar

quests.name: Highland Hides
quests.note: After Young Crocolisk Skins; bugged in the beta (tiny reward)

quests.name: Songblade Search
quests.note: Lakeshire; sources disagree on his coordinates (25.6 vs 30.8, 46.6)

steps.title: Excavation Site: Wetlands (24–29)
steps.body: The path to this new dungeon starts left of Thelgen Rock (53.9, 65.4); the entrance is at 48.1, 56.5. Its diseases are brutal (a big Stamina loss, and one that cuts your damage), so bring a priest, paladin or shaman – or **First Aid disease cures**. One run finishes every quest; the last boss drops a Titan Relic that starts **Lost Relic Carry**.

quests.name: Lost Relic Carry
quests.note: To Prospector Whelgar (38.8, 52.3), then Prehistoric Prism → High Explorer Magellas, Ironforge (69.4, 19.1)

steps.title: Train at 26 and 28
steps.body: Menethil's flight path gets you back to Ironforge quickly. 26: **Curse of Tongues** (slows enemy casters) and **Detect Invisibility**; the Succubus/Incubus **Seduction** grimoire also unlocks. 28: **Banish** and **Create Firestone**, now a weapon imbue that adds fire damage and crit.

steps.title: Boat to Southshore (Hillsbrad Foothills)
steps.body: Take the new boat from Menethil Harbor to Southshore (it continues to Auberdine). Grab the flight path from Darla Harris, bind at the inn, and finish the sleeping bag on top of Thoradin's Wall. Southshore quests are best from about 28, since most targets are level 30+.

steps.title: Southshore quests (28–30)
steps.body: Pick up the Southshore basics and, most importantly, **An Alarming Request** from Emissary Jaques – it's the Alliance key to the City of Dalaran dungeon. Hints of a New Plague? leads on into Arathi Highlands for your 30s.

quests.name: An Alarming Request
quests.note: Unlocks the Alliance Dalaran quests

quests.name: Hints of a New Plague?
quests.note: From level 30

steps.title: City of Dalaran (28–33)
steps.body: This new dungeon is Dalaran in the Alterac Mountains, entered through the sewers at 69.3, 45.6 (on the Silverpine Forest map). With An Alarming Request done, the Image of Archmage Modera at the entrance gives **Starving Arcane**, **Heart of Disruption** and a sewer key; also bring **Power Overwhelming** and **A Green Sample** from Stormwind. Run it once around 30 – lots of mana users for you to drain – but Starving Arcane may need a second run.

quests.name: Heart of Disruption
quests.note: Leads to Friend of the Kirin Tor

quests.name: Power Overwhelming
quests.note: Wizard's Sanctum, Mage Quarter

quests.name: A Green Sample
quests.note: Herbalism trainer in The Park

steps.title: Level 30: Hellfire, Siphon Life and drain tanking
steps.body: Train **Hellfire**, **Subjugate Demon** and Drain Life rank 3, and take **Siphon Life** in the talent tree. From here Warcraft Tavern switches to drain tanking: respec into Improved Drains, Fel Concentration, Improved Life Tap and Soul Siphon, then let your Succubus/Incubus fight while you channel **Drain Life** instead of wanding. The 25-book library reward also needs level 30.

steps.title: Felhunter: Seeking Strahad → Ratchet
steps.body: Pick up **Seeking Strahad** in Stormwind; it sends you to **Strahad Farsan** in Ratchet, on the Barrens coast. In the Forever database the chain continues with three **Tome of the Cabal** quests (Krom Stoutarm in Ironforge, then a Reconstructed Tome plus 3 Rods of Channeling back to Strahad) and ends with **The Binding**, a summon-and-defeat fight. The beta stopped at 30, so nobody has documented this route yet – treat the steps as a preview. The Felhunter is the anti-caster/PvP demon (it removes magic effects and later silences casters).

quests.note: Speak with Strahad Farsan in Ratchet

brackets.title: Stranglethorn, Arathi & Desolace (untested)
brackets.summary: Untested – the beta stopped at 30. This follows the zone tables in current guides; expect to adjust at launch.

steps.title: Zones: Stranglethorn Vale, Arathi Highlands, Desolace
steps.body: Guides agree on Stranglethorn Vale, Arathi Highlands and Desolace for the early 30s, with Alterac Mountains as an extra. Pick up the flight paths at Booty Bay, Refuge Pointe and Nijel's Point as you arrive. Two library books are here: Alterac's ogre fortress (48.5, 57.6) and Witherbark Village in Arathi (73.0, 65.0).

steps.title: Dungeons: Gnomeregan (29–38) and Scarlet Monastery
steps.body: Gnomeregan, the gnomes' old capital, keeps its Classic quests with new rewards; some start with Ozzie Togglevolt in Kharanos. Beta players found it rough for casters because higher-level mobs make your spells miss more. Scarlet Monastery Graveyard (30–38) is the other option.

steps.title: Train at 32 and 34
steps.body: Keep training every even level in Ironforge or Stormwind – there are no Alliance warlock trainers on Kalimdor. Level 32 adds **Shadow Ward**, plus new ranks of your core spells.

brackets.title: Riverglades & Stranglethorn (untested)
brackets.summary: Untested. Riverglades, Forever's big new zone, opens in the mid-30s; The Drowned City dungeon sits in Stranglethorn.

steps.title: Riverglades (35–45): Farholde Keep
steps.body: Blizzard describes Riverglades as a mid-30s to mid-40s zone with 150+ quests for both factions; Farholde Keep is the Alliance hub and Powderfuse Port is the neutral harbour, with a boat to Steamwheedle Port in Tanaris. Guides disagree on the overland entrance (off the Redridge/Burning Steppes road), and the beta had no flight path at Powderfuse Port. Don't try to clear every quest – the huge pool lets you skip weak chains.

steps.title: The Drowned City (35–40)
steps.body: A new underwater dungeon west of Grom'gol in Stranglethorn Vale – your **Unending Breath** finally earns its keep. Its quests and loot haven't been published, so collect anything you see offered nearby before going in.

steps.title: Train at 36 and 38
steps.body: Level 36 adds **Create Spellstone** – a weapon imbue for Shadow damage and spell haste that stacks with wizard oil – and the Felhunter's **Spell Lock** grimoire (silences a caster).

brackets.title: Level 40 milestones, Riverglades & Tanaris (untested)
brackets.summary: Level 40 is the biggest milestone before 60: dual spec, your Affliction capstone Wrack, riding and the warlock Felsteed mount.

steps.title: Level 40: Dual Spec and Wrack
steps.body: At 40 your class trainer sells **Dual Talent Specialization** (reported at 10 gold) – two saved talent setups you can swap between outside combat, e.g. Affliction for questing and Destruction for dungeons. Your 31st Affliction point unlocks **Wrack**, a channeled Shadow drain that makes your other DoTs hit 10% harder (some older guides call it 'Drain Hope'). Train **Howl of Terror** (area Fear) at the same time.

steps.title: Level 40: Riding and the Felsteed
steps.body: Apprentice Riding (60% speed) is listed at level 40 for 100 gold; in Forever you pay for the skill and the mount comes with it. Warlocks get their class mount from **Summon Felsteed** at Strahad Farsan in Ratchet – Warcraft Tavern says the class quest also teaches riding, but forum players were unsure, so bring the gold just in case. The gnome riding trainer is Binjy Featherwhistle at Steelgrill's Depot.

steps.title: Zones: Riverglades, Tanaris, Feralas, Hinterlands
steps.body: Finish the best Riverglades chains, then take the Powderfuse Port boat to Tanaris (Gadgetzan). Feralas (Feathermoon) and The Hinterlands (Aerie Peak) are the alternatives. Death Coil, an instant escape that also heals you, arrives at 42.

steps.title: Dungeons: Krol'dok Stronghold (40–45) and Zul'Farrak
steps.body: Krol'dok Stronghold is a new dungeon inside Riverglades (Blizzard confirmed 40–45), so it slots straight into your questing there. Zul'Farrak (40–47) in Tanaris is the classic alternative.

brackets.title: Tanaris, Feralas & Hinterlands (untested)
brackets.summary: Untested. Keep rotating between the 40s zones; Maraudon and the new Alcaz Island Prison fit here.

steps.title: Zones: Tanaris, Feralas, The Hinterlands
steps.body: Keep working through Tanaris, Feralas and The Hinterlands, with Searing Gorge (Thorium Point) and early Un'Goro as fillers. Move on when the remaining quests get spread out – you don't need to finish every zone.

steps.title: Dungeons: Maraudon (45–51), Alcaz Island Prison (48–53)
steps.body: Alcaz Island Prison is a new dungeon on Alcaz Island in Dustwallow Marsh, easy to reach from Theramore. Maraudon (Desolace) is the classic option. As always: one run with all the quests, then back to questing.

steps.title: Train at 46 and 48
steps.body: Level 48 adds **Soul Fire**, a big fire nuke that costs a Soul Shard. Keep 3–5 shards spare (they don't stack) for summons, Healthstones and Soulstones.

brackets.title: Un'Goro, Felwood & Burning Steppes (untested)
brackets.summary: Untested. Start positioning for 60; dungeon rewards begin to matter as gear, not just XP.

steps.title: Zones: Un'Goro, Felwood, Burning Steppes
steps.body: Guides list Un'Goro Crater (Marshal's Refuge), Felwood (Talonbranch Glade) and Burning Steppes (Morgan's Vigil), with Western Plaguelands (Chillwind Camp) and Azshara as extras.

steps.title: Dungeons: Sunken Temple (50–55), Blackrock Depths (52–60)
steps.body: Sunken Temple (Swamp of Sorrows) and Blackrock Depths (Blackrock Mountain, between Searing Gorge and Burning Steppes) are the classic picks here; Alcaz Island Prison still fits up to 53.

steps.title: Level 50: Inferno
steps.body: Level 50 adds **Inferno**, which calls down an Infernal demon to fight for you for a while. Keep training every even level in Stormwind or Ironforge.

brackets.title: Plaguelands, Winterspring & Mount Hyjal (untested)
brackets.summary: Untested. Finish 60 in the Plaguelands, Winterspring and Silithus, run the two new top-end dungeons, then head to Mount Hyjal.

steps.title: Zones: Plaguelands, Winterspring, Silithus
steps.body: Western and Eastern Plaguelands, Winterspring (Everlook) and Silithus (Cenarion Hold) are the last stretch, plus leftover Burning Steppes, Felwood and Un'Goro quests. From here, quest rewards double as your first level-60 gear.

steps.title: Dungeons: Blackmaw Hold (55–60), Shaper's Terrace (58–60)
steps.body: Two new dungeons close out leveling: Blackmaw Hold in Azshara and Shaper's Terrace in Un'Goro Crater. Classic end-game dungeons (Blackrock Spire, Dire Maul, Stratholme, Scholomance) open at 57–60 and lead into pre-raid gearing.

steps.title: Level 60: Mount Hyjal
steps.body: At 60 your next stop is **Mount Hyjal**, Forever's new end-game zone and raid hub (raids unlock on December 9). Train **Bane of Doom** and **Ritual of Doom**; Journeyman Riding (100% speed) is listed at 1,000 gold. Reach 60 first – Hyjal isn't meant as a 55–60 leveling zone.
